closure_reason: The preregistered/prepointed ZTF and TESS external replication arms both returned zero isolated-B candidates. Remaining incompleteness is explicitly bounded by archive/product availability and sensitivity limitations rather than repaired by post-hoc selection. Aura Oracle's final ANCHOR heuristic recommended returning to the original replication goal after the residual limits were characterized instead of continuing to optimize the same motif.

aura_advisory_lineage.effect: Resolve the eight ZTF unresolved trials with a ZTF-native gate before opening TESS.
Characterize residual ZTF sensitivity and exact product lineage, then move to an independent TESS arm.
Characterize only the two residual TESS sensitivity limits without new pixel reads, then close the specific replication line.

combined_external_replication.note_on_combination: The ZTF and TESS trial definitions, cadence, aperture/PSF methods and denominators differ. The value 63 is descriptive bookkeeping only and is not treated as 63 exchangeable independent Bernoulli trials or as a pooled p-value.

admitted_claim: Across two external optical archives tested with preregistered or prepointed selections, JANUS did not detect a replication of the isolated central B-event motif under the frozen ZTF and TESS candidate gates. ZTF produced zero isolated-B candidates with 23 of 28 quality-admissible trials fully sensitivity-qualified as null and five explicitly characterized unresolved trials. TESS independently produced zero isolated-B candidates with 40 of 42 prepointed trials sensitivity-qualified as null and two explicitly characterized sensitivity-unresolved trials. This closes the present external replication line as a non-replication result with explicit incompleteness, not as proof that transient phenomena or tachyons do not exist.
not_admitted: An all-42 sensitivity-qualified TESS negative result.
Proof that the original LUCI marginal candidate was an artifact or physically disappeared.
A global rejection of short-lived optical or near-infrared transients.
Existence or nonexistence of a physical tachyon particle.
Faster-than-light propagation, retrocausality, backward signaling, UAP origin, artificial origin, ETI, or nuclear causality.

line_state.reopen_condition: A new materially independent scientific question and preregistration, not another post-hoc optimization of the current isolated-B motif.
